item.title: Canadians travelling to China no longer need a visa to enter
item.description: Canadians who want to visit China no longer need a visa to enter the country, but only for a limited time.The Ministry of Foreign Affairs in China announced on Tuesday that starting Feb. 17, 2026, passport holders from Canada and the United Kingdom can travel to the country visa-free."Ordinary passport holders from the two countries can be exempted from a visa to enter China and stay for up to 30 days for business, tourism, family/friends visit, exchange and transit purposes," reads a statement
